from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyPaymentRecord(BaseModel):
    """The 'Cash paid for goods and services' figure from one company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the document")
    cash_paid_label: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label as written, e.g. '购买商品、接受劳务支付的现金'")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The payment amount as reported in yuan")
    unit: str | None = Field(description="The unit of the amount, e.g. 'yuan'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The period the figure covers, e.g. '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    payment_records: list[CompanyPaymentRecord]
